    Mikhail¶

    "I had a robot. She didn't have the government software. I had to hide her." — Mikhail, remembering

    Mikhail was a man on dystopian Old Earth under the totalitarian regime of Sterman — the previous life of Emrys Eisenheart. He was the rebel who refused to comply, the man who ran into the wilderness with his illegal robot, and the one who accidentally slept through three million years in a Sterman Pod.

    The Dystopia¶

    By the mid-21st century, the Shadow-engineered government had completed its takeover. CBDC money — programmable, revocable, surveilled — was the only legal tender. Every citizen carried a neural port. Sterman — the manufactured face of the regime, a god that watched everything — demanded compliance.

    Mikhail owned a robot the state did not: Ichi, a companion unit running on local hardware, without the government surveillance software. Illegal by her very existence. He hid her. When inspections came, she powered down.

    The Flight¶

    When the CBDC collapsed and the government demanded biometric compliance for survival rations, Mikhail did not negotiate. He left — into the wilderness, with Ichi and his closest friend Arkady. Government kill-drones hunted them.

    Ichi was shot in the back — she took a round meant for him. He retrieved her remembrance cartridge, carried it in his port, and kept running.

    The Raid¶

    Starving and desperate, Mikhail found a rebel rendezvous point on a dead man's body. He and Arkady were locked in a room, interrogated daily for a week, treated as infiltrators — until the rebels realized they were just two desperate men who had survived the wilderness.

    On the front line of the raid on an AGI ship facility, Mikhail killed four guards without raising an alarm and turned off the lights. Thousands of rebels poured in. They took the ship and bombarded 24 locations across Earth. The uprising had begun.

    The Pods¶

    Inside the ship: rows of cryogenic pods. Mikhail and Arkady chose two empty pods at the end of a row and lay down to rest. They did not close the doors. The ship malfunctioned. The doors slammed shut. Cryogenization initiated automatically.

    The pods were Sterman Pods — designed to inject occupants with an experimental strain of the Black Agent. The two rebels slept while the agent entered their blood. Neither woke for three million years.

    The Rebirth¶

    In 254 AGD, a volcano breached the bunker of The 157th Colony and freed the black agent into Ge'or's seas. It drifted for over three centuries — until it found a host in the Grimmel Republic in 596 AGD: Annika Eisenheart, of the Eisenheart bloodline.

    In 597 AGD, the twins were born: Emrys Eisenheart and his sister Ichi Eisenheart. The man who refused to comply became the First Protagonist. The robot who took a bullet for him became his twin sister.

    Chi was always going to follow him. She just needed a volcano.
